hero.taglineMi: // Whanaketanga Kēmu Motuhake mai i Aotearoa

features.textEn: We're building something special. A game that combines innovative mechanics with compelling narrative. Follow our journey as we share development updates, challenges, and victories.
features.textMi: Kei te hanga mātou i tētahi mea motuhake. He kēmu e whakakotahi ana i ngā tikanga auaha me te kōrero whakamīharo.

features.textEn: Real talk about game development. We document our wins, our bugs, our late-night debugging sessions, and everything in between. No corporate polish—just honest development.
features.textMi: Ngā kōrero pono mō te whanaketanga kēmu. Ka tuhia e mātou ā mātou wikitoria, ā mātou hapa, me ngā wā patuiro pō.

communityLinks.textEn: Real updates. Real bugs. Real ramen. Come join our discord and help us decide if its a bug or a feature.
communityLinks.textMi: Ngā whakahōu pono. Ngā hapa pono. Rāmene pono. Hono mai ki tō mātou Discord.

communityLinks.textEn:
LFG: Brave souls to wander through our latest build.
Warning: May contain traces of rogue code.
communityLinks.textMi:
E Rapu Ana: He hunga māia ki te hīkoi i tā mātou kēmu hōu.
Whakatūpato: He waehere hē pea kei roto.

communityLinks.textEn: Looking for a sanctuary for creatives? We're building it. Join the pack for art, updates, and good energy.
communityLinks.textMi: E rapu ana i tētahi wāhi haumaru mō te hunga auaha? Hono mai ki te rōpū mō ngā mahi toi.

communityLinks.textEn: We're just some tired nerds making things we love. If that's your vibe, hit wishlist and help us break the simulation.
communityLinks.textMi: He ihumanea ngenge noa iho mātou e hanga ana i ngā mea e arohaina ana. Tāpirihia ki tō rārangi hiahia.

communityLinks.textEn: Catch our latest posts, videos, and updates from across the internet. All in one place.
communityLinks.textMi: Tirohia ā mātou tuhinga, ataata, me ngā whakahōu hou katoa. Kei tētahi wāhi kotahi.
